claims.text: NVIDIA announced on 2026-09-03 (Jensen Huang post) that it has agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12,930,300,000.
claims.context: First-party NVIDIA blog consumed verbatim; agreement value and date as stated.

claims.text: Hugging Face platform scale is stated as 18M+ developers/researchers/creators, 3M+ models, 500K datasets, 1M applications, and 200K+ companies using the platform.
claims.context: Scale figures as stated on the NVIDIA announcement page; vendor-stated counts.

claims.text: NVIDIA commits that Hugging Face remains an open platform: free choice of models, frameworks, clouds, inference providers, and compute; NVIDIA compute not required; continued multi-cloud and multi-accelerator support.
claims.context: Forward-looking openness commitments as announced; conduct obligation, not a completed fact.

claims.text: NVIDIA states it is the largest contributor of open models and data to Hugging Face, with 500+ open models and 250+ open datasets released.
claims.context: Vendor-stated contribution figures about its own activity; externally unreproduced in this run.

limitations.text: Agreement announced, not a closed deal: closing terms, timeline, and regulatory outcomes are not established by this source.
